name: Radiant Nuclear
description: Radiant Nuclear is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Radiant Nuclear is a privately held nuclear energy company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a Series D round of more than $300 million announced on December 17, 2025, was reported to value the company at $1.8 billion.

Founded in 2020, Radiant Nuclear develops portable nuclear microreactors built in a factory, beginning with Kaleidos, a generator rated at one megawatt. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: The company did not disclose the Series D valuation; the figure shown is as reported by TechCrunch. The Series C was first announced by its lead investor, DCVC, at $100 million in November 2024 and closed at $165 million in May 2025, as reported by TechCrunch.
round_notes: Draper Associates and Boost VC led the Series D. In January 2026, Axios reported that the round had grown to $350 million, and in February 2026 the company said Lockheed Martin Ventures had made a strategic investment that further oversubscribed its current financing.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Draper Associates and Boost VC led the Series D, and Lockheed Martin Ventures invested in the same financing in February 2026. DCVC led the Series C. Other investors include Founders Fund, ARK Venture Fund, Chevron Technology Ventures and Friends & Family Capital.
spv_sentence: SEC filings show one special purpose vehicle formed to invest in Radiant Nuclear, organized in 2026.
sources: Sources: Radiant Nuclear's announcements dated December 17, 2025 and February 17, 2026; DCVC's announcements of the Series C and Series D; a TechCrunch report dated December 17, 2025; reporting by Axios (January 2026); and SEC Form D filings.
